step1_analysis.description: A high-speed differential amplifier that provides both transimpedance and limiting gain functions. It features an auto-zero DC feedback network to cancel offsets and maintain a high dynamic range.

paper_reference.title: 6-k 43-Gb/s Differential Transimpedance-Limiting Amplifier With Auto-Zero Feedback and High Dynamic Range

voltage_gain.description: Differential voltage gain when operated as a limiting amplifier

sky130_expected.calculation: Using SKY130 NMOS at 1.8V, the intrinsic gain (gm*Rout) is lower than InP HBTs. Assuming gm ~ 10mA/V and Rload = 100 ohms, single-stage gain is ~1 V/V. With multiple stages or higher load, 20-30 dB is achievable.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Lower supply voltage (1.8V vs 3.3V) and CMOS technology reduce the achievable gain compared to the specialized InP process.

sky130_expected.calculation: SKY130 130nm NMOS has an fT of roughly 40-60 GHz. Amplifier bandwidth is typically fT/5 to fT/10 depending on the topology.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Silicon CMOS is significantly slower than InP HBTs, so the 35 GHz bandwidth will scale down proportionally to the fT of the process.

sky130_expected.calculation: VDD=1.8V. Assuming 5 tail current sources at ~3mA each, total current is ~15mA. Power = 1.8V * 15mA = 27mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Scaled down VDD (1.8V vs 3.3V) and typical CMOS testbench bias currents result in much lower power consumption.

sky130_expected.calculation: Zt = Vout/Iin. 76 dB ohms = 6.3 kOhms. In CMOS with 100 ohm loads, Zt will be lower, heavily dependent on the feedback resistor (R3).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on load resistors and internal voltage gain, which are lower in 130nm CMOS.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC voltage gain, bandwidth, and transient output swing of the TIALA. The NPN transistors are mapped to SKY130 NMOS devices via a subcircuit to evaluate CMOS performance.
step3_testbench.spice:
* TIALA Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt
.param W_n=10u L_n=0.15u

* Map NPN to SKY130 NMOS for CMOS evaluation
.subckt npn_mos d g s
XM1 d g s GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_n} l={L_n}
.ends

* DUT (Q replaced with X to use subcircuit, passives given typical values)
X1 OUTN DINP N3 npn_mos
X2 N10 N10 N18 npn_mos
X3 N3 N17 N11 npn_mos
X4 N3 N21 N13 npn_mos
R1 OUTN N6 100
X5 N3 N15 N12 npn_mos
X6 N3 N20 N9 npn_mos
X7 N18 N14 N8 npn_mos
R2 OUTP N6 100
X8 ITDRV TLDRV1_TLRX1 N7 npn_mos
X9 OUTP DINN N3 npn_mos
R3 N2 DINN 500
C1 N2 GND 1p
R4 N1 3_3V 100
R5 N7 GND 50
X10 N3 ITDRV N19 npn_mos
C2 3_3V GND 10p
R6 N11 GND 50
R7 N2 N2 1
C3 N1 GND 1p
R8 N10 REFMON 1k
R9 3_3V N6 10
R10 3_3V N10 1k
R11 N19 GND 50
R12 N13 GND 50
R13 N12 GND 50
R14 N14 N16 1k
R15 N9 GND 50
R16 N8 GND 50
X11 N1 N2 N3 npn_mos
R17 N1 MON 1k

* Biasing
Vdd 3_3V GND 1.8
Vbias1 N17 GND 0.8
Vbias2 N21 GND 0.8
Vbias3 N15 GND 0.8
Vbias4 N20 GND 0.8
Vbias5 N14 GND 0.8
Vbias6 TLDRV1_TLRX1 GND 0.8
Vbias7 ITDRV GND 0.8

* Inputs (Soft voltage drive to allow auto-zero feedback to operate)
Vinp_src inp_src GND dc 1.2 ac 0.5 sin(1.2 0.05 1G)
Vinn_src inn_src GND dc 1.2 ac -0.5 sin(1.2 -0.05 1G)
Rinp inp_src DINP 500
Rinn inn_src DINN 500

* Dummy loads for floating monitor nodes
Rref REFMON GND 1Meg
Rmon MON GND 1Meg
Rn16 N16 GND 1Meg

* Dependent source for differential output
Eout out_diff 0 OUTP OUTN 1

.control
* DC Operating Point & Power
op
let power = -i(Vdd) * 1.8
print power

* AC Analysis for Gain and Bandwidth
ac dec 50 1Meg 100G
let gain_db = vdb(out_diff)
meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=10Meg
meas ac bw_freq when gain_db=(dc_gain-3) fall=1

* Transient Analysis for Output Swing
tran 1p 5n
meas tran vout_pp pp v(out_diff)

quit
.endc
.end
